articles.title: 2026 will be 'year of autonomous': Analyst on Tesla, Waymo robotaxis
articles.mainIdea: 2026 will be 'year of autonomous': Analyst on Tesla, Waymo robotaxis
articles.summary: Yahoo Finance Video: 2026 will be 'year of autonomous': Analyst on Tesla, Waymo robotaxis. 2026 is on the road to being the "year of autonomous" driving as Tesla (TSLA) and the Alphabet-owned Waymo (GOOG, GOOGL) seek to expand their robotaxi services to other major US cities. Wedbush Securities managing director of equity research Scott Devitt weighs in on the biggest themes and investing plays around self-driving technology, and how he sees 2026 playing out for rideshare companies Uber (UBER) and Lyft (LYFT). Catch Scott Devitt's top three consumer internet stock picks heading into 2026. Also watch Yahoo Finance's interview with University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign associate professor Katherine Driggs-Campbell about the recent behavior shifts in autonomous vehicles' driving habits To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Catalysts. Related tickers mentioned: GOOG, LYFT, TSLA.
